contract: Track B data interchange contract v1
semantics: All records are AUTOMATED_CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED with evaluation_ref null ('not evaluated').
LOW_RELIABILITY_CANDIDATE types (DISTINGUISHES, APPLIES, EXPLAINS, DOUBTS) and CONSIDERS are not exported; they remain in the native A5 graph with that marker.
DISAPPROVES (declaratory 'does not lay down the correct law') maps to OVERRULES_OR_LIMITS_PROPOSITION with candidate_id prefix 'a5.disapproves.'; it is not an explicit overruling.
Absence of an edge never means absence of adverse authority.
validation: python -m mimamsa_contract record candidate <decompressed file> --register config/restricted_material.json (tests/test_legal_audit_c13_graph_contract_v1.py)
